title: Error Handling & Optimistic Responses
description: Master error handling patterns and optimistic UI updates with Apollo Client for resilient user experiences.
longDescription: This module covers comprehensive error handling in Apollo Client including network errors, GraphQL errors, error policies, and implementing optimistic responses for instant UI updates. You will learn to handle partial data failures, display meaningful error messages, and create smooth user experiences with optimistic UI patterns.
whatYouLearn: Handle network errors and GraphQL errors separately
Configure error policies to control error behavior
Implement optimistic responses for instant UI updates
